overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for HVL: the standardised heading set (Innhald og oppbygging, Læringsutbytte, Krav til forkunnskapar, Undervisnings- og læringsformer, Obligatorisk læringsaktivitet, Vurderingsform) maps cleanly, learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, and coursework is correctly separated from assessment in the random controls. Most pre-pass flags (boilerplate, short, empty, no sections) are false alarms; only a few small defects remain in the profesjonsemne plans.

findings.evidence: Anbefalt litteratur: Komplementerende kunnskap i grunnskolelærerutdanningene Eilifsen, Margareth (red.); Risøy, Bodil Kjesbo (red.) Universitetsforlaget, 2021, Totalt omfang: 200 s.
findings.description: An inline 'Anbefalt litteratur:' line at the end of the last theme block is left inside course_content; no reading_list section is emitted for the course. By the codebook the literature belongs in reading_list.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The literature is a run-in label inside a paragraph under 'Innhold og oppbygning', not a heading, so the block reader never sees a boundary. No HVL page in the packet has a literature heading at all, so reading_list is absent institution-wide, which is probably correct for HVL (reading lists are published elsewhere).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start rule in sectionize()/.clean_sections() that moves lines beginning with 'Anbefalt litteratur' / 'Pensum' / 'Litteratur:' into reading_list, or accept as rare.

findings.evidence:
Obligatorisk oppmøte og aktiv studentdeltakelse.
Karakterskala: Bestått/Ikke bestått.
findings.description: In the profesjonsemne plans the Vurderingsform text is a mandatory-attendance requirement (a pass/approve gate), which the codebook places in coursework_requirements, yet it is filed as assessment (and is duplicated by the coursework_requirements row).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source page itself puts the attendance requirement under Vurderingsform; the extractor follows the heading, and the heading map has no content-based override.
findings.suggested_fix: For assessment blocks whose text starts with 'Obligatorisk oppmøte', move that line to coursework_requirements; or leave as is since it only affects the Profesjonsemne family.

findings.evidence: Det er ingen vurdering i emnet.
findings.description: Assessment row is only a 'no assessment' placeholder sentence. It is true to the source, but is emitted as a row with substantive-looking text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for 'Det er ingen vurdering i emnet' in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Det er ingen vurdering i emnet' to the placeholder patterns so the row is dropped or flagged; low priority.
